# Solana PRO _(in progress)_

The architecture patterns behind the top protocols on Solana, inferred from the code of the TOP-50 projects. 

The engineers and architects behind the best protocols keep producing great designs, and it isn't luck or good positioning. It comes from an elite intrinsic mindset. Whether the field is tokenomics, engineering, or software architecture, the best decisions rarely come from copying what a textbook says. They come from a strong intrinsic mindset combined with a deep knowledge of patterns.

Many of these patterns go unnamed and that's why they are intrinsic. They live quietly in people's heads and most people never even realize the patterns they use to come up with decisions. 

We went through the top 50 protocols, analyzed them, inferred the patterns behind them, and gave those patterns names. That is exactly what you'll find in this course.

The course is written to the point. You won't read through formal, padded language. Instead, you'll get precise definitions and clear explanations of each pattern and the lessons we can draw from it.
